episodes.title: COURT HEARING: Kenya Cult Leader Found Guilty of Murdering 191 People | Court Hearing | AB1Z
episodes.description:
A Kenyan court has found a cult leader guilty in a case involving the deaths of 191 people. The footage captures proceedings from the court hearing as the verdict is delivered.

The case has drawn attention to one of Kenya’s most serious cult-related tragedies.
